name: NOAA Global Surface Temperature Dataset (NOAAGlobalTemp v5)
description: NOAAGlobalTemp (NOAA Global Surface Temperature, Version 5) is the operational climate benchmark maintained by NOAA's National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI) to track global and regional temperature changes from 1880 to the present. The dataset merges land surface air temperatures from GHCN-Monthly v4 with ocean sea surface temperatures from the Extended Reconstructed Sea Surface Temperature dataset (ERSSTv5). Output is provided on a 5°x5° monthly latitude-longitude grid alongside operational global, hemispheric, and tropical area-weighted time series, providing key inputs for NOAA's State of the Climate reports.
